collections.name: The Human Condition
collections.description: Love, fragility, identity, resilience and the choices that shape us. Figurative symbolism and dreamlike stories with a human heart.

collections.name: Words That Matter
collections.description: Urban energy, expressive faces and artworks with something to say. Some communicate through imagery rather than literal lettering.

collections.name: Mediterranean Soul
collections.description: Warm light, coastlines, terraces and imagined Mediterranean atmospheres. These are artistic interpretations, not specific documented locations.

collections.name: Earth & Emotion
collections.description: Earth colours, botanical forms, texture and pared-back compositions for an expressive yet calm interior.

collections.name: Studio Archive
collections.description: Painterly studies, geometric experiments and other landscapes from the wider studio. Browse these without confusing them with the four featured collections.
